name: Collectible Spawn Timing works like VV1-3
description: **Needs no other patch.** Makes collectibles come less often, as in The Secret City; off by default. A mushroom or collectible appears on its own with a chance of 4 in 6,000 each update of the village in The Tree of Life, against 3 in 6,000 in The Secret City (the same game engine), so about a quarter more often. With this patch the chance is The Secret City's 3 in 6,000, and in heavy rain (weather strength above 50) its second roll is 3 in 6,000 too. Fog's Wind Flute chance, rain making everything a mushroom, island events, the ghost and every other spawn are unchanged. New Believers needs no such patch: its timing already is The Secret City's.
behavior_changes: The random spawn roll 0x4143A8 compares rand(6000) with 3 (stock 4) outside fog; in fog (weather 4) the stock Wind Flute threshold (pieces / 2) x 4 is kept. The second roll above weather strength 50 (0x4143CF) compares with 3 (stock 4).
explicit_non_changes: What appears (mushroom or collectible, its rarity), at most 2 random items out, their 90-second lifetime, fog's Wind Flute chance, rain's all-mushroom spawns, island events, the ghost and every other spawn are unchanged.
Two guarded in-place edits (the 42-byte roll block, rewritten to the same length, and one immediate); no code is added and no executable space is claimed.
evidence_status: implemented from exact-build disassembly; the thresholds in fair weather, rain, fog with 0 to 12 Wind Flute pieces and heavy weather are emulated stock and patched in tests/test_collectible_spawn_like_vv3.py; runtime/player confirmation pending

the second roll above weather strength 50 (0x4143CF): rand(6000) < 3 (stock 4)
